status: setup: world and bots built, NOT started; blocked on the model endpoint

host.why: retired since September, no players, already runs Paper 1.21.8 build 60 (the showcase's build) as a service; the large node has about 131 GB RAM free at 33% CPU
host.old_world: its August testbed world stays where it is, never deleted; the rehearsal is a new level name beside it

host.layout: /srv/rehearsal/{server,releases,harness,tools,secrets,ops,snapshots}; units rehearsal-paper.service and rhbot@<name>.service (installed, bots not enabled); built by infra/freshworld/setup-rehearsal.sh
host.old_services: minecraft.service and observe-fleet.service (the August testbed) stopped and disabled 11-14; the old world directory is untouched
host.firewall: on: ssh and the game port from the lab network only; RCON is local

world.name: fw-s12

site.known_difficulty: 32% tree cover (old-growth birch and dark forest): heavy felling before any plot is clear
site.source: the 2026-11-10 seed screen (seeds.md, site table); chosen offline from a seed copy, as the owner approved on 11-06
site.chosen_by: infra/showcase/site_search.py from the scouted centre: 1 of 9 candidates passed the town-plan limits, 48 blocks south-east of it (the centre itself: core relief 7 > 5, 9.7% wet > 3%)

world.admin_edits_before_day0: none: chunk generation and the world rules above only
world.world_rules: the project's standard, as on every world (scripts/place-town.py world_rules via infra/showcase/pregen.py): gamerules, WORLD SPAWN AT THE HOME, border radius 5000 centred on the home, chunks pre-generated to 1,024 blocks. No block was placed or removed.
world.server_settings: the showcase's live server.properties (the repo base with allow-flight=true); no plugins (the showcase has CoreProtect, SkinsRestorer and spark: logging, skins and profiling only)

code.sha_rule: the showcase release that is live when the run starts; rehearsal 0 does not wait for the one-trunk merge
code.flags_file: /srv/rehearsal/harness/env/rh0-*.env on the VM (12 files, 46 keys each), built by infra/freshworld/make_rehearsal_env.py from the release's control.env
code.flags_rule: a copy of the showcase's settings taken at the start, kept beside this manifest's run record with its sha256
code.release: 46286e9e-6dd0ded8-fdd64ead (roofclimb-01show; the showcase release live since 2026-11-14 06:21Z), copied whole from the showcase VM; all 226 source files match the git commit blob for blob
code.unit_setting: SHOP_COOLDOWN_MS=180000, the showcase's one live unit drop-in

brain.endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:11612 (gemma4:26b), the showcase's setting, NOT connected: no tunnel is installed on this VM
brain.measured_2026-11-14: the 14 showcase bots made 15.2 answered calls a minute (7,287 in 00:00-08:00Z), mean 4.0 s, p95 8.4 s; summed call time was 102% of the clock, so the Studio model was busy the whole time. 12 more bots would add about 86% more demand. No spare capacity was measured.
brain.outage: since 2026-11-14 08:31Z the Studio does not answer on its ssh port from the showcase VM or the controller: the showcase had 0 answered calls and about 1,440 failed calls an hour from 09:00Z to 14:00Z

bots.pool_name_why: 35 switches in the release default to the pool name `showcase` and one size table compares against it; another name would switch the town features off. The world, host and state directories are separate, and rows are told apart by exp.instance = rehearsal and exp.block = rehearsal-0.

rules.admin_edits: none: no teleport, no give, no setblock or fill, no world-file edits
rules.owner_one_off_repairs: each one is an assistance entry and marks the run assisted
rules.code_changes: allowed in a rehearsal; each one is logged with its sha and the run restarts from the day-0 snapshot
rules.restart_rule: a restart is a new run id (rehearsal-1, rehearsal-2, ...) with its own manifest copied from this one
rules.finish_line_runs_differ: 7 days, code frozen, any code change or admin edit restarts the 7-day clock

daily_card.written_by: scripts/host/rehearsalcard.py --manifest <this file> on the VM (tests: scripts/host/test_rehearsalcard.py, 28 checks, 7 mutants)

criteria.measure: bots whose newest position is within 64 blocks of the home / bots
criteria.pass: all (the world spawn is at the home, so this is a check that they stay, not a journey)

criteria.measure: the workshop (`shop`, the first project of every town) completed
completed house, cottage or hall plots that still stand when re-read
criteria.note: "still standing" is not re-read yet; the card says so

criteria.measure: a completed storehouse, storehub or shopchest
longest STUCK goal, grounds clean-up included
criteria.note: unread for now: no stuck-goal reader runs on the rehearsal host

criteria.measure: bots inside a 2-block box for a whole clock hour

daily_card.note: the 48-hour thresholds are rehearsal targets set on 11-14, not the finish-line thresholds; the 7-day ones are in docs/reports/finish-line-2026-11-09.md

telemetry.stream: the bots' own log files on the VM (/var/log/mcai/rh0-*/skill-*.jsonl and llm-*.jsonl), read with scripts/lib/telemetry.py; a separate host, so nothing mixes with the showcase or the fleet
telemetry.elasticsearch: not shipped: a writer account limited to rehearsal index names would have to be created on the log host first (as infra/showcase/es-showcase-setup.sh does for the showcase)
telemetry.proof: none yet: no bot has run, so there is no row to count; the card prints the row, bot and hour totals of every read as its positive control

start_procedure: connect the model endpoint and prove one answered call from the VM
start rehearsal-paper.service and wait for Done
start the 12 rhbot@ units 12 s apart
write started_at (UTC) into the copy of this manifest on the VM and here
run rehearsalcard.py at +1 h, then daily
